Bug fixes, correctness improvements, and optimizations
Documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the vendor.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund MLabs Core Tool Maintenance & Enhancement for Plutarch and Ply annual maintenance and enhancement.

claims.claim: Plutarch is a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts through controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply serializes Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.
MLabs counted at least 26 teams building with Plutarch and Ply in a recent internal audit, while the rationale later states a conservative count of at least 15 teams.
MLabs' public cross-language benchmarks show Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in the benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory.

The proposed funding period is intended to cover ongoing Cardano ledger, Plutus, and tooling evolution, including protocol-era compatibility for major ledger updates such as the Dijkstra era if relevant changes land.
The proposal claims continued maintenance will reduce friction, migration risk, uncertainty, bespoke workarounds, and avoidable rewrites for teams maintaining production systems.
The proposal claims alignment with Cardano 2030 Pillar 2, specifically Adoption & Utility and A.3 Developer Experience for open-source SDKs, frameworks, and infrastructure.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The requested amount is 1,162,746 ada, consisting of 1,128,880 ada for Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility, and developer experience plus a 33,866 ada Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The proposal states the withdrawal does not exceed the applicable 350M Net Change Limit at the moment of submission, either on its own or in aggregate.

Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with named reserve and project-specific addresses, multi-party authorization rules, an oversight committee, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ada for annual maintenance and enhancement of MLabs' Plutarch and Ply tooling, routed through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, with stated priorities around breakages, protocol compatibility, fixes, optimizations, documentation, and developer experience.
